subject: Company Dissolution / Strike-Off
detail: Attempting to dissolve or strike off an insolvent company to avoid paying creditors is a serious misuse of the Companies Act 2006 provisions. subject: Restructuring Plan
detail: A Restructuring Plan, introduced by the Corporate Insolvency and Governance Act 2020 (CIGA 2020) establishing Part 26A of the Companies Act 2006, is a court-sanctioned process for viable companies allowing a compromise with creditors and/or shareholders. It can impose a plan on dissenting creditor classes, known as 'cross-class cram down', if the court deems it 'fair and equitable', with approval typically requiring a majority in number representing 75% in value within each class.
